about: Every publication this project prepares, and where each one stands. docs/PUBLISHING-PAPERS.md explains the steps and the statuses; node tools/paper-check.js checks each entry against its files, and allows no email address in a paper's files except author.email. Update this file in the pull request that changes a status.

papers.title: Minimal winding in the self-similar collapse of three point vortices and of two concentric vortex polygons
papers.note: Ready for arXiv once the code DOI is in its data availability paragraph (papers/minimal-winding/submission/CHECKLIST.md).

papers.title: A sharp winding bound for the self-similar collapse of three point vortices in the alpha-models
papers.note: Not peer reviewed and not cleared for submission (CHANGELOG.md). Before it can go public, the checks it cites in research/generalizations-2026-09-24/ must move into its code/ and data/ folders (node tools/paper-sync.js --check alpha-winding).

papers.title: Closed forms and sharp minima of ω t_c on three classical point-vortex collapse families
papers.note: Zero confirmed novel findings; a Zenodo record of its own is planned (identities/README.md), not a journal submission. Its links into this repository must be replaced before the record, since this repository may be private.

papers.title: GENChase: seeded scientific simulations with validation records, provenance and print export
papers.note: Journal of Open Source Software draft; JOSS needs the software DOI from Zenodo before acceptance (docs/PUBLISHING.md, section 4).
